meta.source: design/theme.toml (midnight tone, pink accent, macOS sizes); text-tertiary and the control sizes from the settings canvas, which theme.toml has no tokens for

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The window or screen behind everything: the settings window's main pane.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Holds content: boxes of rows, the settings sidebar.

tokens.name: elevated
tokens.usage: Content that floats: sheets, popovers, an elevated card.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: The fill of a text field.

tokens.name: field-hover
tokens.usage: A text field under the pointer.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Where artwork is missing: a plain tile, no glyph.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed controls: the track of a progress bar or slider.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Raised controls: a secondary button, a pop-up menu.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent text, glyphs, slider fills, the focus ring, a chosen radio. As text, on background, surface and elevated.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: The primary button's fill and the selected segment; text on it is on-accent-fill.

tokens.name: accent-selection
tokens.usage: A selected table row and the highlighted menu item. Text on it is on-fill.

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: The blue accent (268°) as text and glyphs, on background, surface and elevated.

tokens.name: accent-blue-fill
tokens.usage: The blue accent's fill: its swatch in the accent picker, and the primary button when blue is chosen.

tokens.name: on-accent-blue-fill
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent-blue-fill.

tokens.name: accent-blue-selection
tokens.usage: A selected row when blue is chosen; text on it is on-fill.

tokens.name: accent-orchid
tokens.usage: The orchid accent (313°) as text and glyphs, on background, surface and elevated.

tokens.name: accent-orchid-fill
tokens.usage: The orchid accent's fill: its swatch in the accent picker, and the primary button when orchid is chosen.

tokens.name: on-accent-orchid-fill
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent-orchid-fill.

tokens.name: accent-orchid-selection
tokens.usage: A selected row when orchid is chosen; text on it is on-fill.

tokens.name: on-accent-pink-fill
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent-pink-fill.

tokens.usage: The mint accent (166°) as text and glyphs, on background, surface and elevated.

tokens.name: accent-mint-fill

tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent-mint-fill.

tokens.name: accent-sky
tokens.usage: The sky accent (213°) as text and glyphs, on background, surface and elevated.

tokens.name: accent-sky-fill
tokens.usage: The sky accent's fill: its swatch in the accent picker, and the primary button when sky is chosen.

tokens.name: on-accent-sky-fill
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent-sky-fill.

tokens.name: accent-sky-selection
tokens.usage: A selected row when sky is chosen; text on it is on-fill.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: accent at opacity-tint: a selected row, an accent chip's fill.

tokens.name: accent-tint-strong
tokens.usage: accent at opacity-tint-strong: a selected row under the pointer.

tokens.name: logo-word
tokens.usage: The word under the sheep on Welcome, beside the glow: the wool's cream in dark mode, the outline's plum in light mode, both from the sheep's drawing.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text and labels, on background, surface, elevated and field.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Values, notes and secondary labels, on background, surface, elevated and field.

tokens.name: mac-text-secondary
tokens.usage: macOS's own secondary label colour (NSColor.secondaryLabelColor, measured: white at 0.549 alpha in Dark, black at 0.498 in Light), which the Mac app draws secondary text with. Inside a Mac window, and anything marked `bae-mac`, it stands in for text-secondary. The Mac code uses the system colour, never this value; text-secondary is Android's.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and an unchosen radio's ring. Below 4.5:1 on elevated by design: never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and what broke: an error line, a red field ring, a failed status. As text, on background, surface and elevated.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done and healthy: Synced. As text, on background, surface and elevated.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention but routine: Offline. As text, on background, surface and elevated.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information in a notice or chip. As text, on background, surface and elevated.

tokens.name: activity
tokens.usage: Work in progress, such as a transfer or an upload. As text, on background, surface and elevated.

tokens.name: pinning
tokens.usage: Files downloading to stay on this device. As text, on background, surface and elevated.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: danger at opacity-tint: the fill of a danger chip, behind danger's own text.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: success at opacity-tint: the fill of a success chip, behind success's own text.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: warning at opacity-tint: the fill of a warning chip, behind warning's own text.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: info at opacity-tint: the fill of a info chip, behind info's own text.

tokens.name: info-notice
tokens.usage: The fill of an info notice. Light: a pale blue under on-notice text and the info glyph. Dark: a solid light blue under on-notice text and glyph, since a see-through tint over the dark background reads grey.

tokens.name: success-notice
tokens.usage: The fill of a success notice, as info-notice.

tokens.name: warning-notice
tokens.usage: The fill of a warning notice, as info-notice; a see-through yellow over dark turns brown, so dark is solid.

tokens.name: danger-notice
tokens.usage: The fill of a danger notice and error box, as info-notice.

tokens.name: danger-icon
tokens.usage: The filled status icon in danger's tone (a notice's leading icon). Light: danger in OKLCH with lightness +0.06 and chroma ×1.25, since a filled shape needs less darkness than text. Dark: danger mixed 65% with text-secondary.

tokens.name: warning-icon
tokens.usage: The filled status icon in warning's tone (a notice's leading icon). Light: warning in OKLCH with lightness +0.12 and chroma ×1.45, since a filled shape needs less darkness than text. Dark: warning.

tokens.name: info-icon
tokens.usage: The filled status icon in info's tone (a notice's leading icon). Light: info in OKLCH with lightness +0.12 and chroma ×1.45, since a filled shape needs less darkness than text. Dark: info.

tokens.name: success-icon
tokens.usage: The filled status icon in success's tone (a notice's leading icon). Light: success in OKLCH with lightness +0.12 and chroma ×1.45, since a filled shape needs less darkness than text. Dark: success.

tokens.name: on-notice
tokens.usage: Text, and in dark the glyph, on info-notice, success-notice, warning-notice and danger-notice.

tokens.name: notice-accent
tokens.usage: Accent text (a text button, a link) on a toned notice: the accent in light, on-notice in dark where the accent would vanish on the solid fill.

tokens.name: activity-tint
tokens.usage: activity at opacity-tint: the fill of a activity chip or notice.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: text-secondary at opacity-tint: the fill of a neutral chip or notice.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows, a card's edge.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: A divider that must read stronger.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Laid over a control or row under the pointer.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Laid over a control while pressed.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the window behind a sheet.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The shadow under a sheet or an elevated card.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind the image viewer.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent-selection, status fills and artwork.

tokens.name: on-fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on fills and artwork.

tokens.name: on-accent-fill
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent-fill: the sheep's outline color.

tokens.name: on-accent-fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on accent-fill.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The library's page heading at its largest.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The one heading of a welcome or empty screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: A sheet's title, a settings pane's heading.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: The main line of a list row.

styles.name: strong
styles.usage: A section heading over a box of rows; emphasis in body text.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Labels, values, buttons, fields and error lines.

styles.name: detail
styles.usage: A note under a control; a row's second line.

styles.name: fine
styles.usage: The smallest print: counts and timestamps.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: The label in a status chip.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: A small label above a group, in sentence case as current macOS and Android set them.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Codes and paths: a restore code, a bucket name.

tokens.name: space-hairline
tokens.usage: A hairline's width.

tokens.name: space-line
tokens.usage: Between the lines of one text block; a chip's vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-inline
tokens.usage: Between a glyph and its text.

tokens.name: space-compact
tokens.usage: A chip's horizontal padding; tight groups.

tokens.name: space-related
tokens.usage: Between related items: the buttons of a footer.

tokens.name: space-group
tokens.usage: Between groups; a row's and a notice's inset.

tokens.name: space-hang
tokens.usage: How far a marker hangs left of the text edge it sits beside: a disclosure chevron's width and its gap.

tokens.name: space-edge
tokens.usage: From a container's edge to its content: a sheet's inset.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-page
tokens.usage: Around a page.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Skeleton and progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Status chips; an icon button.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Fields, buttons, pop-up menus, notices and row highlights.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and boxes of rows; a sheet's lower corners.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Floating panels and prompts.

tokens.name: radius-artwork
tokens.usage: Cover art in rows and lists.

tokens.name: radius-cover
tokens.usage: A release's cover shown large.

tokens.name: opacity-tint
tokens.usage: A color laid behind its own text: a chip, a notice, a selection.

tokens.name: opacity-tint-strong
tokens.usage: The same where it must read stronger, as under the pointer.

tokens.name: opacity-off
tokens.usage: A control that is off, as drawn on the canvas; the platforms draw their own.

tokens.name: size-row-artwork
tokens.usage: Cover art in a list row.

tokens.name: size-bar-artwork
tokens.usage: Cover art in the now-playing bar.

tokens.name: size-hit-target
tokens.usage: The least an icon button takes to press.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: The height of a button and pop-up menu at macOS regular size.

tokens.name: size-field
tokens.usage: The height of a macOS text field.

tokens.name: size-lead
tokens.usage: The leading column of a row (MacItem): the icon or status glyph before its text, centred in it, the text starting space-related after it. A notice's glyph sits in the same column, so a row's title, a notice's words and the rows under them share one edge.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: The least height of a row in a box.

tokens.name: icon-badge
tokens.usage: A glyph inside a chip.

tokens.name: icon-small
tokens.usage: A glyph beside small text: a row's chevron.

tokens.name: icon-medium
tokens.usage: A glyph beside body text; an icon button's glyph.

tokens.name: icon-large
tokens.usage: A toolbar glyph.

tokens.name: icon-hero
tokens.usage: An empty or failed state's glyph.
